author_purpose: Translation between rigorous mathematical exposition and the Lean proof for mathematicians new to proof assistants; use the developed formal proof to improve the paper.
source_reading: Complete v16 TeX read continuously; new constructions and statement/proof correspondence checked in detail. Previously reviewed material retained exactly.

governing_source.title: Knuth, Larrabee and Roberts, Mathematical Writing
governing_source.consulted_scope: Section 1 and Sections 4–5; official Stanford PDF consulted through web, retained retypeset report used for local text. Identities are distinguished in the v14 source-review record.

Dosen_Petric_source.purpose: Union definition/laws, existing-arrow zero context and the cited isomorphism list; existing literature comparisons otherwise preserved.

Lean_source_links.checks: Each source path, hash, declaration opening and line; exact selected maximality header after Not notation expansion; actual short_maximality call sequence. All target URIs present in PDF annotations.
Lean_source_links.scope: Typed statements and relevant proof steps/constructions, with previous reverse-audit source reading reused; not independent review of every body in the production library.

important_dependency_decisions: Section 6 may deduce union laws from faithfulness; Appendix D.5 instead uses source-equation derivations before positive coherence.
DNF/CNF expansions are retracts; only the displayed one-sided equations are used.
E.3 uses explicit sourceConj and mixedDisj structural paths rather than quotient negation, whose equality-respect theorem uses coherence.
q/e inverse equations are coherence consequences in B(P), with the zero witness printed.
Named union laws are in Reduced; B(P) statements are obtained through the proved reduction/recovery hom maps and the printed relational argument.
No extra constant-substitution, empty-P thinness or finite-hom deduction is promoted to a new selection or added statement.
